name: Arduino UNO R4 Minima (SKU ABX00080)
frame: Request gives only the SKU: tests looking up ABX00080 as the Arduino UNO R4 Minima and building to its outline (68.58 x 53.34, 1 mm PCB, 8.5 mm headers, +z up, USB-C end at -x). The -x end stays open because the datasheet locates only the USB-C top edge (0.73 + 6.4 + 3.88 = 11.01 mm from the back edge, 3 mm tall) and does not draw the DC jack. -z is the PCB's underside: the headers are through-hole and the drawing gives no height for their leads below the board, so -z is not covered at a slip gap; the case must bear on it (support -z) in three of its four quarters, on standoffs or a ledge.
